string.text:
A first-generation TASER Axon Body chest camera (#73002) with a wide-angle lens, a top-right mechanical power slider and a pre-RapidLock holster mount. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.

Generation 1 of 5, the most basic, like the real 2013 camera: 480p through a 130-degree lens (the narrowest view), heavy grain and compression, colour fringing, strong rolling shutter, blown highlights and a noisy picture in the dark. Overlay: date and device only. Auto-exposure and footage review; no LTE, so no markers or event log. Sold by traders; also craftable (basic toolkit).

Runs on a standard battery for 12 in-game hours, like the real camera (default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

A rugged second-generation Axon Body 2 chest camera (#74001) with a rubberized bumper shell, a side power switch, a RapidLock rear mount and a yellow Delta event button. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.

Generation 2 of 5, like the real 2015 camera: 1080p through a 143-degree lens, grainy and compressed, noisy in the dark. Overlay: date, device and name. Auto-exposure and footage review; no LTE, so no markers or event log. Crafted from an Axon Body 1 (basic toolkit, basic electronics recipes).

Runs on a standard battery for 12 in-game hours, like the real camera (default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

A third-generation Axon Body 3 chest camera with an octagonal armored housing, a top monochrome status LCD, four microphones and a RapidLock mount. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.

Generation 3 of 5, like the real 2019 camera: 1080p at about 143 degrees, less motion blur, still some grain and compression. Onboard GPS adds the GPS line; LTE brings the event log and markers for friends and enemies, with companion dots at the screen edge. No mutant identification or tags through scopes. Crafted from an Axon Body 2 (advanced toolkit, advanced electronics recipes).

Runs on a standard battery for 12 in-game hours, like the real camera (default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

A fourth-generation Axon Body 4 chest camera with a wide-angle lens, top status display, time-stamped overlay and friend-or-foe tag display. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.

Generation 4 of 5, the reference camera, like the real 2023 camera: 1440p through a 160-degree lens, picture as set in the MCM. Event log, identification of stalkers and mutants, tags through scopes, auto-exposure and footage review. Crafted from an Axon Body 3 (advanced toolkit, advanced electronics recipes).

Runs on a standard battery for 14 in-game hours, like the real camera (default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

A fifth-generation Axon Body 5 Pro chest camera with a recessed sapphire-shielded wide-angle lens, high-visibility top OLED display, dual programmable side buttons and high-efficiency electronics. Carry it anywhere in your inventory and it records on its own.

Generation 5 of 5, the best, like the real 2026 camera: up to 4K, the cleanest and sharpest picture, the least compression and night noise. Every feature, with the fastest identification. Crafted from an Axon Body 4 (expert toolkit, expert electronics recipes).

Runs on a standard battery for about 16.8 in-game hours, +20% over Axon Body 4 like the real camera (default settings): drag a battery onto the camera to swap it. When the charge runs out the camera shuts off, but the recording clock keeps counting.

Full-battery recording time of Axon Body 4 in in-game hours: 14 like the real camera. The other cameras follow their real battery life (Body 1-3: 12 h, Body 5: about 16.8 h). Runs on game time, so a faster time factor drains faster in real minutes; sleeping and loading do not drain. Also scaled by the difficulty battery consumption setting, and the highest-charge / newest-generation camera is selected automatically.

Play a first-person animation when the battery dies (take the camera off, look at it, put it away) and when you put a new battery on it (slide the battery in, clip the camera back on). Off: the camera just turns off and on.
Body camera: this model has no footage playback

Each Axon Body generation matches the real camera's published specs: resolution, field of view, low-light noise, compression and battery life, plus live map and identification from Body 3 (LTE). The overlay adds the name from Body 2 and the GPS line from Body 3. Your MCM effect settings stay your preference: the camera scales them up or down and turns off what it does not have. Off: every camera has Axon Body 4's picture and every MCM feature (only battery life differs).

A compact Axon Flex POV remote point-of-view camera head and shielded tether that plugs into an Axon Body 4 or Axon Body 5 unit to move the lens off your chest rig and onto your helmet or collar.\n\nCompatible only with Axon Body 4 and Axon Body 5 (Generations 4-5; has no effect on Body 1-3). While carried alongside an active Body 4 or Body 5, switches the overlay label to AXON FLEX POV, reduces chest sway, and eliminates chest/weapon occlusion. Crafted on a workbench (advanced toolkit, advanced electronics recipes).
